## In-Country Missions

In 2026, the Secretariat conducted five technical assistance missions to Comoros, Kenya, Madagascar, Oman and Tanzania. These missions combined reviews of national fisheries data collection and management systems, technical discussions and practical support for implementing IOTC reporting requirements. They also provided opportunities to identify priorities for continued collaboration and capacity development.

## Virtual Technical Meetings

The Data Section also maintained technical exchanges with CPCs to clarify reporting requirements, review submissions and follow up on ongoing data improvement activities ([Appendix I](#AppDataSectionActivities)).
